meta.title: Green Ecolution
meta.description: Smart green space management for liveable cities.

tooSmall.body: The loop is laid out for 16:9 at 1920 × 1080, the way it runs at the trade-show booth. On this screen the type and the scenes are too cramped to read.

quote.statement: We water and hope for the best.

water.body: is what Flensburg puts on its urban trees each year, with no data to go on and plenty of manual work on site.

sensor.statement: The soil says when to water.
sensor.body: Capacitive sensors measure soil moisture and temperature at two depths, 40 and 80 centimetres.

lorawan.body: Green Ecolution builds on the state-wide network of Schleswig-Holstein with more than 420 gateways instead of running its own.

map.statement: One look at the map is enough.
map.body: A traffic light system shows which green spaces need water.

history.statement: Time series instead of gut feeling
history.body: Real readings from the soil, from ten sites in Flensburg since May 2026.

planning.body: Combine vehicles, teams and tree groups into one watering plan.

tour.body: Water capacity, refill points and access restrictions all feed into the route. Export as GPX for the navigation device.

inspection.statement: The state of every tree, right on site.
inspection.body: Staff see on the tablet which tree needs water, and log the watering right away.

team.statement: Born at Flensburg University of Applied Sciences.
team.body: Coordinated by Smarte Grenzregion, developed to production readiness by PROGEEK GmbH.

open-source.body: Funded by the state of Schleswig-Holstein through “Offene Innovation: Open Source made in SH”. In pilot operation with TBZ Flensburg.

more.body: On Instagram we report from the running pilot. The website has the project in full, the blog and every release.

demo.body: All of it live in your browser.

closing.body: For sustainable, data-driven green space care.

spot-problem.statement: 50,000 litres a year, spread on a hunch.
spot-problem.body: That is what Flensburg's urban trees get, watered by experience and gut feeling.

spot-sensor.statement: The soil says when to water.
spot-sensor.body: Sensors measure moisture at 40 and 80 centimetres.

spot-map.statement: One look at the map is enough.
spot-map.body: Traffic-light colours show which tree needs water.

spot-planning.statement: Water goes where it is needed.
spot-planning.body: Put assignments together and optimise the routes.

spot-origin.body: Born at Hochschule Flensburg, developed further by PROGEEK, coordinated by Smarte Grenzregion.
